merge_policy.baseline_source: accepted G50 final_v4 normalized observations and coverage

model_track.kernel: exp(-D^2 / (2 * lengthscale^2)) with unit prior variance
model_track.lengthscale_rule: median of strictly positive pairwise training-fold distances

stop_at.rule: any variant passing the frozen calibration gate is a claim-language decision requiring PI review and Matt's ack
